pricing.heading: Aircond Installation KL Prices
pricing.paragraph: The prices below are for basic wall-mounted installation and include 5 feet of copper pipe plus 5 feet of wiring.

extras.title: Extra Copper Pipe
extras.description: Charged for every foot required after the included 5 feet, based on HP and pipe specification.

extras.title: Extra Wiring
extras.description: Charged for every foot required after the included 5 feet or when a new power point is needed.

extras.title: Old Unit Removal
extras.description: Quoted separately according to HP, access and site condition.

extras.title: Additional Work
extras.description: Hacking, special brackets, high-level installation and concealed piping are quoted separately.

pricing.qualification: * RM220 and RM280 apply to basic wall-mounted installation. Any extra material or additional work is explained and charged separately based on actual measurement and site condition.

items.question: How much is aircond installation for 1.0HP and 1.5HP?
items.answer: The base installation price is RM220. It includes 5 feet of copper pipe, 5 feet of wiring, basic drainage connection, vacuum and basic testing.

items.question: How much is aircond installation for 2.0HP and 2.5HP?
items.answer: The base installation price is RM280. It includes 5 feet of copper pipe, 5 feet of wiring, basic drainage connection, vacuum and basic testing.

items.question: What happens if the copper pipe or wiring is longer than 5 feet?
items.answer: Every additional foot is charged according to the actual measurement, aircond HP, material specification and site condition.

items.question: Can you install an aircond that I bought myself?
items.answer: Yes. Send the brand, model, HP and site photos so the team can review the initial installation scope.

items.question: Is removal of the old aircond included in the base price?
items.answer: No. Dismantling an old unit is additional work and is quoted according to HP, access and site condition.

items.question: Do I need a site visit before getting a quote?
items.answer: An initial estimate can be given through WhatsApp when you send your KL location, aircond HP and photos of the indoor and outdoor areas.

items.question: Do you install aircond for offices and shops?
items.answer: Yes. This service is available for homes, condos, offices, shops and small commercial spaces in Kuala Lumpur.

finalCta.heading: Get an Aircond Installation KL Quote
